column1: # Graphics functions. One row per function, per task it belongs to. Tab-separated; see finder.py for the rules.

column7: summary
Opens a graphics window of a given width, height and colour depth.
Opens a graphics mode by mode number, or picks the work and visible pages.
Sets the title of the graphics window.
Returns the fullscreen resolutions for a colour depth, one per call, then 0.
Fills in the screen's width, height, depth and driver, or the desktop's if none is open.
Sets or reads graphics library settings, such as the driver or the window position.
Returns the address of an OpenGL procedure by name, or 0 if it is not found.
Plots one pixel, in the given colour or the current foreground colour.
Plots one pixel, in the given colour or the current background colour.
Draws a line between two points, or a box or filled box with B or BF.
Draws a circle, ellipse or arc, optionally filled.
Fills the area enclosed by a border colour with a colour or a pattern.
Draws a figure from a string of pen commands such as "U10 R10".
Returns the colour of a pixel, or -1 if it is off the screen or image.
Returns the x or y position of the Draw pen.
Draws text at a pixel position, on a transparent background, with an optional font.
Returns an opaque colour value from red, green and blue parts of 0 to 255.
Returns a colour value from red, green, blue and alpha parts of 0 to 255.
Sets or reads the colours of a palette mode, or restores the default palette.
Creates an image of a given size filled with one colour; returns 0 on failure.
Frees an image made by ImageCreate.
Fills in an image's width, height, bytes per pixel, pitch and pixel pointer.
Copies a row of pixels to another buffer, converting its colour depth.
Copies a rectangle of the screen or an image into an image buffer.
Draws an image onto the screen or another image, with a choice of blending method.
Copies source pixels over the destination unchanged, as a Put method.
Copies pixels with Put but skips the mask colour, magenta or index 0.
Blends pixels with Put by each pixel's alpha, or by one alpha value you give.
Adds source and destination colour values with Put, capped at 255.
Combines source and destination pixels with a bitwise And, as a Put method.
Combines source and destination pixels with a bitwise Or, as a Put method.
Combines source and destination pixels with a bitwise Xor, as a Put method.
Calls your own function for each pixel to combine source and destination in Put.
Loads a BMP file or BSave data onto the screen or into memory.
Saves memory or the screen to a file, as a BMP image if the name ends in .bmp.
Stops screen updates while you draw, so the user never sees half a frame.
Resumes screen updates after ScreenLock and shows what was drawn.
Sets which page is drawn on and which page is shown.
Copies one graphics page onto another, by default the work page onto the shown one.
Copies one graphics or text page onto another.
Shows the OpenGL back buffer, or copies a page as ScreenCopy does in other modes.
Waits for the display to finish drawing a frame, to reduce flicker.
Returns a pointer to the work page's pixels, or 0 if no graphics mode is set.
Sets the rectangle that drawing is clipped to, or resets it to the whole screen.
Sets the coordinate system mapped onto the current view.
Converts a coordinate between the Window system and physical pixels.
Fills in the mouse position, wheel and buttons, or -1 in each if there is no mouse.
Moves the mouse pointer, shows or hides it, or keeps it inside the window.
Returns -1 while the key with a given scancode is held down, or 0 if it is not.
Fills in a joystick's buttons and axis positions; returns 0 on success or 1.
Returns -1 if a mouse, keyboard or window event is waiting, and fetches it.
Holds one event fetched by ScreenEvent: its type and its key or mouse data.
Runs a program of controls: start-up, the message loop, forms with callbacks, DPI.
Colours every control from one light or dark theme that can follow Windows.
Lets the user type text in a themed frame, on one line or several.
Lets the user pick a number with minus and plus buttons, or type it.
Lets the user type a date or pick it from a dropdown calendar.
Shows one or more month grids inside your window for choosing a day.
Draws a push button with an optional caption and icons on either side.
Draws a checkbox, checked or unchecked, with an optional caption.
Draws a radio button; checking one in a group unchecks the others.
Draws an on and off switch: a pill with a knob at one end.
Shows a list, tree or multi-column report of rows you paint, with in-place renaming.
Shows the current choice on a button that drops down a list of the others.
Shows a row of labels with a line under the current one, for switching views.
Shows a strip of tabs that can be selected, closed and dragged to a new place.
Shows a menu bar of items such as File and Edit, each with its own dropdown.
Shows a strip of command buttons; items that do not fit move into an overflow menu.
Shows a strip of icon buttons and toggles, spaced exactly as you declare.
Shows panels of text in a strip along the bottom of a window.
Draws a divider between two panes that the user drags, and reports where it went.
Scrolls a page of ordinary child controls that is taller than the space for it.
Draws a vertical scrollbar for content whose scrolling you manage yourself.
Draws a horizontal scrollbar for content whose scrolling you manage yourself.
Shows a themed modal message box with an optional icon and one to three buttons.
Shows a modal colour picker and returns true with the colour, or false if abandoned.
Shows a themed tooltip near the cursor, with an optional title, wrapping and fade.
Draws a progress bar, flat or gradient, solid or in blocks, or with no known end.
Draws a line, column, price or pie chart from the series you supply.
Paints a window offscreen and copies it in one go, so drawing never flickers.
Loads an icon, PNG, BMP or JPEG file so a control can show it in an icon slot.
Shows a themed popup menu with checks, accelerator labels and nested submenus.
Draws a band of resizable column headers above a list or grid.
Switches the controls' tooltips between the system tooltip and PsTooltip.
Keeps what each control needs from the message loop, the theme and DPI changes.
Runs a tkControls program: start-up, the event loop, forms, fonts and the theme.
Keeps the shared light and dark theme every tkControls control takes its colours from.
Draws an editable text box, single-line or word-wrapped multiline, with its own editor.
Draws a numeric spinner: a typed value between minus and plus buttons, kept in range.
Shows an editable date field with a calendar icon that drops down a month calendar.
Draws a month calendar, one month or a grid of up to twelve, with drill-down to years.
Embeds a Scintilla code editor as a tkControls widget, with lexing, folding and IME.
Draws a momentary command button with an optional glyph or image on either side.
Draws a two-state checkbox with an optional caption on either side of the box.
Draws a radio button whose group allows at most one checked choice.
Draws an on/off switch: a rounded track and a knob that marks the state.
Shows a scrolling list of rows you paint that is also a tree, with columns and editing.
Shows the current choice on a button that drops a scrolling list of the alternatives.
Draws a strip of text panels where exactly one is current, marked by a line beneath it.
Draws a row of document tabs that scroll, close and reorder by drag.
Draws a window's menu bar, whose items drop down tkPopupMenu menus.
Draws a toolbar of command, toggle, split and dropdown buttons that overflows to a menu.
Draws a row or column of icon-only buttons, toggles and separators.
Draws a status bar of text panels, one of which stretches to fill the leftover width.
Draws a draggable divider bar between two panes and reports where the user drags it.
Scrolls a page of ordinary child widgets that is taller than the space it is shown in.
Draws a vertical scrollbar that you size, feed a range, and listen to.
Draws a horizontal scrollbar that you size, feed a range, and listen to.
Shows a themed modal message box and returns the id of the button that closed it.
Shows a modal colour picker popup and returns the colour and alpha the user chose.
Shows the system open, save and folder dialogs and returns the chosen paths.
Shows an owner-drawn tooltip for a widget after the mouse rests on it.
Draws a horizontal or vertical progress bar, determinate or with a running marquee.
Draws line, column, HLOC and pie charts from series of labelled values.
Runs every tkControls widget: SDL windows, the widget tree, input, timers and fonts.
Paints shapes, text and images for tkControls widgets on SDL_Renderer and SDL_ttf.
Parses, formats and dispatches keyboard shortcuts for tkControls surfaces.
Loads an image file once and draws it in any tkControls window.
Shows a popup menu of commands, separators, check marks and submenus.
Draws a band of column headings with draggable dividers and one column taking the rest.
Runs the one scrollbar engine behind tkVScrollBar and tkHScrollBar.
Lists the fonts installed on the machine by family, style and file.
Drives tkControls self-tests by pushing real SDL input events and checking the results.
Provides the base a designed form extends: a window, its layout, show and close.
Shows a line or block of text that the user can't edit.
Shows an image, scaled or clipped to its area.
Groups controls on a plain background, with an optional border.
Frames a set of controls under a caption.
Shows one page of controls at a time under a strip of tabs.
Keeps controls placed as the window resizes, by Anchor or Dock.
